faqs.q: What equipment does Kỹ Sư Thập Cẩm supply?
faqs.a: Our reference range covers PLCs, HMIs, inverters, servos, sensors and industrial components. Send the model, specifications and quantity so we can confirm the selection, availability and a quote.

faqs.q: I am not sure which model to choose. Can you advise?
faqs.a: Yes. Send the process stage, technical requirements, installation conditions and the equipment you currently use, and we will work out the required specifications together.

faqs.q: I only need a single sensor or component. Can I ask?
faqs.a: Yes. Send the part number or a photo of the nameplate, the specifications and the quantity you need, and we will check what fits.

faqs.q: What should I prepare when asking about equipment?
faqs.a: If available, prepare the model or part number, photos of the nameplate, wiring diagrams, operating specifications, installation environment and quantity.
Our contact point is in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Delivery and support coverage are confirmed for each request.
